info.title: AI PDF Studio sidecar API
info.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio, newline-delimited UTF-8 JSON. stdout = protocol only; stderr = scrubbed logs. Notifications: job.progress (ProgressNotification), chat.delta (StreamDelta), job.finished (JobResult). Every error response carries data: ErrorData. Methods with x-job=true return a JobId immediately and finish via job.finished; cancel with job.cancel. x-network tags drive the UI's offline/online label.

x-authentication: Every JSON-RPC request includes an out-of-band per-process auth field. The Flutter supervisor generates the token and passes it to the sidecar at startup.

methods.name: system.handshake
methods.summary: Negotiate contract version and discover capabilities.

methods.name: system.health
methods.summary: Liveness probe.

methods.name: system.shutdown
methods.summary: Graceful shutdown; sidecar also exits on stdin EOF.

methods.name: job.cancel
methods.summary: Cancel a running job. Idempotent.

methods.name: job.result
methods.summary: Fetch the final result of a job (also delivered as notification job.finished).

methods.name: pdf.inspect
methods.summary: Metadata, page count, encryption, scanned-likely detection.

methods.name: pdf.extractText
methods.summary: Page-aware text extraction.

methods.name: pdf.unlock
methods.summary: Write a decrypted copy given the password. Original untouched.

methods.name: pdf.merge
methods.summary: Merge PDFs in order.

methods.name: pdf.split
methods.summary: Split by ranges or every N pages.

methods.name: pdf.pageOps
methods.summary: Rotate, delete, reorder, duplicate, extract, insert blank pages; writes a new file.

methods.name: pdf.compress
methods.summary: Lossless-first compression with optional image downsampling; reports real before/after size.

methods.name: pdf.annotate
methods.summary: Write standard PDF annotations (highlight, underline, strike, note, ink, shape, text, stamp).

methods.name: pdf.stamp
methods.summary: Page numbers, headers/footers, watermark, signature image.

methods.name: pdf.encrypt
methods.summary: Password protect / set permissions (AES-256).

methods.name: pdf.sign
methods.summary: Create a digital signature (PKCS#12 supplied by user).

methods.name: pdf.verifySignatures
methods.summary: Validate signatures; reports trust honestly (valid/invalid/unknown-trust).

methods.name: redaction.apply
methods.summary: True redaction with mandatory verification. Fails the job if redacted text is still extractable.

methods.name: ocr.detect
methods.summary: Is this PDF scanned? Per-page text-layer coverage.

methods.name: ocr.run
methods.summary: OCR to searchable PDF and/or text. Cancellable; per-page progress.

methods.name: convert.toPdf
methods.summary: Image/TXT/HTML/Word/Excel/PowerPoint to PDF.

methods.name: convert.fromPdf
methods.summary: PDF to DOCX/XLSX/PPTX/JPG/PNG/TXT/HTML. Result carries quality warnings.

methods.name: compare.run
methods.summary: Compare two PDFs: text diff, page/metadata diff, optional visual diff, exportable report.

methods.name: library.upsert
methods.summary: Register or update a document reference and reading state.

methods.name: library.list
methods.summary: Recents, favorites, folder, tag, or filename/content search.

methods.name: library.remove
methods.summary: Remove from library only. Never deletes the file.

methods.name: library.relocate
methods.summary: Point a missing document at its new path.

methods.name: library.exportUserData
methods.summary: Export all user data (library, notes, chats) as JSON.

methods.name: library.deleteData
methods.summary: Delete caches, chat history, or everything.

methods.name: index.build
methods.summary: Incremental background indexing (extract, OCR if enabled, chunk, embed). Local embeddings by default.

methods.name: index.status
methods.summary: Indexing state for a document.

methods.name: search.hybrid
methods.summary: Keyword + vector search with rank fusion, restricted to one document.

methods.name: chat.ask
methods.summary: Grounded Q&A. Streams chat.delta notifications. Only retrieved chunks are sent; consent required.
methods.description: Final result contains verified citations only. If retrieval has no supporting evidence the answer is the fixed 'not in document' response with zero citations.

methods.name: tools.run
methods.summary: Summarize, notes, quiz, translate, writing assist. Result has page references.

methods.name: provider.test
methods.summary: Test connectivity and key with a minimal request containing no document content.

methods.name: usage.get
methods.summary: Local metering counters (AI credits, OCR pages) for the current period.

methods.name: entitlement.set
methods.summary: Apply a signed entitlement token obtained by the app (Store/backend). Verified against an embedded public key.

Path.description: Absolute Windows or POSIX path on the local machine.

DocumentId.description: Stable ID of a library document (sha256 of canonical path + size + mtime bucket, assigned by library.upsert).

Password.description: Transient. Never logged or persisted by the sidecar.

scannedLikely.description: True when most pages have no extractable text; UI offers OCR.

fraction.description: null means progress is genuinely unknown. Never simulated.

quote.description: Verbatim excerpt from the retrieved chunk, never model-authored.

missing.description: File moved/renamed/deleted on disk; UI offers Locate or Remove.

RedactionVerificationFailed.message: Redacted text still extractable; output discarded

ConverterUnavailable.message: No converter available for this format on this machine

ConsentRequired.message: User consent required before sending document content
